wish: someone should make an app that records a sound and plays it back after a set delay
spec:
Records the microphone continuously and plays it back to your speakers or headphones after a delay you set, 0 to 10 seconds in half-second steps.
Pick a preset or nudge with -/+ 0.5 s, tap start, allow the microphone; the delay can be changed while it runs and is remembered.
It does not save or upload audio, and nothing leaves the device.
notes: Live delay line via Web Audio DelayNode; echo cancellation on to limit speaker feedback. Microphone requested only on tap.
